subject: Geopolitics
title: Hydrogen: The Next Frontier
description: A quick, practical guide to Hydrogen: The Next Frontier.

hook.text: Green hydrogen is made by splitting water with renewable energy.

buildup.text: Hydrogen can store and transport energy. Countries with cheap solar and wind can produce it for global export.

discovery.text: Australia, Chile, and Morocco are racing to become hydrogen exporters. A new map of energy trade is forming.

twist.text: Hydrogen is expensive and inefficient today. It loses energy at every conversion step.

climax.text: Hydrogen could reshape energy geopolitics entirely, but only if costs fall enough to compete with fossil fuels.

punchline.text: Water plus sun equals fuel. If the price is right.

quiz.question: What is the main barrier to green hydrogen adoption?
options: There is not enough water on Earth
It is currently too expensive and loses energy in conversion
No country has the technology to produce it
